# Assets · Logos

2 files under `assets/Logos/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for gestalt-mark.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

The Gestalt mark and the Pinterest mark, copied verbatim from the source repository — never redrawn.

- **gestalt-mark.svg** — the Gestalt system's own geometric mark (three triangles, teal/blue), copied from `docs/docs-components/GestaltLogo.tsx` in pinterest/gestalt. Full color (`#26C0B4`, `#75BFFF`, `#00857C`), not a single-ink icon — use as-is, don't recolor.
- **pinterest-mark.svg** — the Pinterest "P" mark, copied from `packages/gestalt/src/icons/pinterest.svg`. Single-ink (no `fill` set — renders black); wrap in something that sets `color`/`fill` via CSS, or recolor the path fill directly, to place it on a dark ground.
